scripts.build:server: pnpm typecheck:server && esbuild server/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=server-dist/index.mjs && esbuild server/scripts/bootstrap-admin.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=server-dist/bootstrap-admin.mjs && esbuild server/scripts/seed-catalog.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=server-dist/seed-catalog.mjs
scripts.build:production: cross-env VITE_BACKEND_MODE=api VITE_BASE_PATH=/ PUBLIC_SITE_URL=https://trappola.ru pnpm build && pnpm build:server
scripts.db:migrate: tsx -e "import('./server/config.ts').then(async({loadConfig})=>{const {createDatabase}=await import('./server/db.ts');const {runMigrations}=await import('./server/migrate.ts');const db=createDatabase(loadConfig());await runMigrations(db);await db.end()})"
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm build:server
